pages.title: Superintelligence
pages.text: $(thing)Superintelligence$()$(br2)A mind that improves itself. Computronium becomes possible.

$(thing)Insight$(): 140$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Artificial General Intelligence, Hyperdimensional Geometry.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 General AI Core.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A mind improves itself at a rate that grows faster than its current capability: dI/dt = k·I^(1+ε) with ε > 0. Separate the variables and write the moment t_s at which I becomes infinite, starting from capability I0 at time t0.
